newsitem.title: FINLAND: Clinton, Yeltsin said working on five draft texts.
newsitem.headline: Clinton, Yeltsin said working on five draft texts.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton and Russian President Boris Yeltsin are working on five draft texts at their summit and the American side is hopeful of progress, an administration official said on Friday.

The official, who spoke on condition of anonymity, said the texts covered five subject areas that are the main topics of the U.S.-Russia talks -- NATO enlargement, the START II strategic arms reduction treaty, missile defences, chemical weapons and economics.
"Every time there's a summit, whatever areas are discussed, people try to record it on paper," he said, adding: "We're hopeful of progress."
Clinton and Yeltsin are due to hold a news conference later on Friday after their summit.
